transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I, um... I came in because I'm just so tired. It's like I can barely get through a shift at work anymore. I feel like my body is just filled with wet sand, you know? And even when I try to rest, it doesn't really help. I just can't seem to get my energy back.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?

Um, I'm not really sure if sad is the right word. I haven't really noticed feeling down, exactly. It's more just... I'm just so drained. I'm not sitting around crying or anything like that. I mostly just feel too exhausted to really care about much right now.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like?

Not really, no. Um... things I usually love doing, like cooking for myself or playing my guitar, they just feel really flat now. Even hiking, or going over to my family’s place... it's like I'm just going through the motions. I feel like I'm only pretending to care when I do them.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?

Yeah, I have. I just... I keep thinking I let everybody down lately. My manager, my family, my little nieces... it feels like I'm failing them. And when I'm at work, I just replay every little mistake I make at the cash register over and over in my head. It just feels like it proves I’m no good.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or the opposite, feeling restless and unable to sit still?

Actually, it's kind of been both. Um, a while ago, I couldn't stop pacing around the store at work. I was just constantly moving and straightening things up because I couldn't just stand still. But lately... it's the exact opposite. Everything just feels really heavy now. Even just walking to the bus after my shift, or taking a second to answer a question... it all just feels really slowed down and takes a lot of effort.
Have you been having any thoughts about hurting yourself?

Yeah, I have. Um... I've had some pretty scary thoughts lately. Mostly just thinking that maybe everyone would be better off if I just didn't wake up in the morning. And... a few times on the way home from work, I've actually caught myself thinking about just stepping off the curb right into traffic. It just kind of pops into my head.
Are there any activities that you still find yourself looking forward to?

Not really, no. Things I usually love just feel... flat now. Like, I used to really enjoy cooking for myself, or playing my guitar, even just going for a hike. And going over to my family's place used to be a big deal for me. But now... it's like I'm just going through the motions. I don't actually care about any of it anymore, I'm just pretending to.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Well, this low, empty feeling... it's been going on for about four months now. It started a while after that whole rush of energy I had at work finally wore off.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight over the past few months?

Yeah, I think I have. My appetite has been kind of all over the place, honestly. But lately, I mostly just forget to eat. Or when I do try to eat something, it just tastes like cardboard, so I don't finish it. I haven't actually stepped on a scale to check the exact number, but I've definitely noticed that my work pants have been fitting a lot looser than they used to.
Have you been fidgeting or feeling an inner restlessness lately?

Well, it kind of changed. When I had all that energy a while back, I couldn't stop moving. I was constantly pacing around the store, just straightening shelves and rearranging things. I couldn't sit still. But lately... it's the opposite. Everything just feels slowed down and heavy. Even just walking to the bus stop after my shift, or... or trying to answer a customer's question... it takes so much effort. I just feel sluggish.
Are you still experiencing periods where you can't stop moving or pacing?

No, not anymore. Like I just mentioned, that was... that was earlier on. At first, I really couldn't stop pacing around the store and straightening things up. But lately, no. It's completely the opposite now. Everything just feels slowed down and heavy, like I was saying... even just walking to the bus or answering a customer's question. I definitely don't have the energy to pace right now.
Have you felt consistently depressed or empty most of the day, nearly every day, for the past two weeks?

Not really. I mean, I wouldn't say I feel sad or... or empty. I'm not sitting around crying or anything like that. It's more just what I was talking about before—just feeling really heavy and drained. So, no, I don't think I feel depressed, just... really tired, I guess.
Do you feel depressed most of the day?
No, like I was just saying, I really don't feel depressed. I don't feel sad most of the day or anything. It's just that heavy, sluggish feeling I mentioned. But no, not depressed.
Do you feel like you're depressed most days?
I... didn't you just ask me that? No, I really don't. Like I just said, I don't feel depressed or sad most days. It's just that heavy, exhausted feeling I was talking about. But no, not depressed.
Are there any activities that you used to enjoy, but now find no pleasure in?

Yeah. Things I usually love doing... like cooking for myself, playing guitar, hiking, or going over to my family’s place... they just feel really flat right now. It's like, if I do them, I'm only pretending to care.
Have you been feeling restless or having trouble sitting still recently?

Well, it's actually changed recently. At first, yeah, I couldn't stop pacing around the store and just straightening things up constantly. I couldn't really sit still at all. But lately, it's the exact opposite. Everything just feels really slowed down and... heavy. Like, even just walking to the bus after work, or trying to answer a question... it all just feels slow and takes a lot of effort now.
Have you lost more than 5% of your body weight over the past month?

I'm not sure about the exact percentage, but my appetite has been all over the place. Lately, though, I mostly just forget to eat. Or when I do, the food just tastes like cardboard, so I don't eat much. I have noticed my work pants have been fitting a lot looser recently, so I guess I must have lost some weight.
Do you feel sad most of the day?

I wouldn't really call it sad. Like, I'm not sitting around crying or feeling upset about anything in particular. It's more just... I don't know, I just feel kind of blank most of the time. Like there's just nothing really there.
Do you feel depressed?

I don't know if I'd use the word depressed. I mean... I'm not really sure what that's supposed to feel like exactly. Like I was just saying, it's mostly just that blank feeling. I just don't really feel much of anything at all right now.
